params.1273: Sell an item to a shop to make some inventory space.
params.1274: <col=FFFFFF>Right-click</col> any tutor (the characters with round icons over their heads) and select <col=FFFFFF>trade</col>.
params.1275: You can sell things to the shop by <col=FFFFFF>right-clicking</col> them in your inventory and choosing how many to sell.
params.1276: Close the shop when you're done.
params.2225: Selling unwanted goods to a shop is a quick way of turning them into money. Some shops won't buy all items because they specialise in a certain item type.
